description: Γενική Διεύθυνση Βιώσιμης Ανάπτυξης & Κλιματικής Αλλαγής: electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Γενική Διεύθυνση Βιώσιμης Ανάπτυξης & Κλιματικής Αλλαγής. Coverage: Γενική Διεύθυνση Βιώσιμης Ανάπτυξης & Κλιματικής Αλλαγής. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Εφεδρικά Ηλεκτροπαραγωγά Ζεύγη ΠΕ Νοτίου Τομέα Αθηνών; Ηλεκτροπαραγωγά Ζεύγη; Ηλεκτροπαραγωγά ζεύγη. Formats seen: XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
